Cloud collaboration tools
Cloud Voice
Cloud Voice is a hosted VoIP phone system that combines all the features of a traditional phone system with the flexibility of the cloud.
Digital Voice for Business
A tailored, scalable, and flexible suite of business tools for modern collaboration. It brings together voice calls, video conferencing, and desktop sharing to support effective communication with both colleagues and customers. Setup takes as little as 30 minutes for smaller teams, with no technical hassle.
Cloud Work
Collaborate with colleagues and customers over voice, video, or instant messaging using our cloud-based system.
MiCloud
Enjoy our unified communications platform to boost your organisation’s productivity and customer experience.
Microsoft Teams
Enjoy all the functionality of Microsoft Teams with the upgraded ability to make cloud-based voice calls.
One Cloud Cisco
A unified cloud-based communication solution for voice, instant messaging, video, desktop sharing, and more. Trusted by critical national infrastructure providers.
Webex Calling
Keep your teams connected wherever they work with Webex Calling, a voice solution powered by AI and backed up by BT’s secure global voice network.
Zoom
Discover a faster, smarter way to communicate with built-in AI features from BT and Zoom, all supported by BT’s global voice network.
Webex Meetings
Webex Meetings with BT is a secure, cloud‑based collaboration service with advanced AI features such as real‑time transcription, automatic summaries and action items, smart polling, and multilingual translation.

A flexible cloud platform that combines with your on-premise call centre solution.
Nuance Gatekeeper
Protect customer interactions with a fully scalable authentication and fraud prevention solution.

Plans for 250+ employees
Corporate mobile plans flexibly designed to adapt to your evolving business needs and grow with your business.

Discover Android Enterprise to make your devices work better for big businesses. Enjoy flexible options like Zero-Touch Enrolment for remote management and make the most of Android.
Apple for corporates
Discover a suite of Apple business products, mobile solutions and finance options designed to quickly adapt to your needs.
Samsung for corporates
Easily deploy and manage your mobile fleet and keep your devices secure from mobile threats with Samsung Knox.

Mobile security

4G & 5G network solutions
Connect your workplaces, vehicles and devices with mobile connectivity solutions, wherever you work.
5G Private Networks
Private networks enable every device, sensor, machine and system to connect and share more data across a dedicated, ultra-reliable, ultra-low latency ecosystem. With your own private network, you have better visibility and control of your business operations.
Internet of Things (IoT)
We can help your business gather data from devices and sensors, analyse it and use it to streamline operations with IoT.

Mobile communication tools
Our mobile communication tools integrate perfectly with your business systems, making it easier to connect.

Cloud security
Keep your cloud-based data, information and networks secure with our intelligent cloud security.
Firewall security
Protect your most important assets with a managed firewall. Core protection for the constantly evolving threat landscape.
DDoS security
Don’t let a distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack take you down. With our DDoS security, you can detect and neutralise attacks before they hit your network.
Privileged Access Management (PAM)
Help employees access the apps they need wherever they’re based without compromising your security.
Threat management
Threat intelligence
Protect your critical assets and stay ahead of cyber-attackers with intelligence you can act upon.
SIEM
Get full visibility across your entire estate with our ready-to-use and fully managed SIEM services.
EDR and XDR security
Protect your endpoints, networks, cloud and email with our managed solutions from Microsoft and CrowdStrike.
Operational technology
Keep your manufacturing pipeline secure and get better visibility and control over your OT assets.

Affordable and scalable security solutions to protect your reputation, your team and your clients.

Drone detection
Explore our tailored Drone Detection services with BT Business. Comprehensive protection including airports, stadiums, and critical infrastructure.
Drone Survey Services
Explore our professional Drone Survey Services with BT Business. Delivering precise data and insights for property, commercial, and infrastructure projects.
Drone SIM
Enhance your drone’s capabilities with BT Drone SIM cards from BT Business. Achieve extended range, high-altitude flights, and uninterrupted connectivity.
Project Skyway
Paving the way for regular drone flights. Find out more about the UK’s first drone corridor.
SD-WAN & SASE
SD-WAN
Establish a flexible, safe network. SD-WAN gives you secure access to applications via landline, broadband, and 4G/5G.
SASE
Eliminate the burden of purchasing and managing hardware. SASE gives you a cloud-based security set-up that safeguards all users, regardless of their location.
Cloud Edge
Edge Compute
Make the most of Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) by bringing real-time data analysis closer to the point of need.
Connected Cloud Edge
Integrate your cloud services and ecosystems to address the increasing demand for cloud connectivity.
Cloud Connect Direct
Establish a direct connection from your private network to leading cloud service providers through WAN connectivity.
Connected Cloud Colocation
House your IT infrastructure securely within a protected data centre environment.
Cloud solutions
Managed cloud services
Bring your private and public network into a single, secure network without the worry of having to manage them yourself.
Private Cloud
Bring together an infrastructure platform, full private cloud software stack and managed services in a single, trusted package.
Data centre colocation
Lower costs and improve security by hosting your services in third-party data centres. Enjoy 24/7 secure access and constant power.
